ErrorPrediction.title: ErrorPrediction

segment.title: Segment

time.title: Time

pre.title: Pre

PanelCheck.title: PanelCheck

ParentCandidate.description: A categorical column that could sit above the group in a hierarchy (039).

Parser.title: Parser
Parser.description:
How to read a stored value in its analysis type, applied at query time.

- raw: the stored value as is
- number: text with a given decimal separator (thousands separators, %, currency stripped)
- date: text with a strptime format
- boolean: text mapped with true/false vocabularies (empty lists: cast the value)
- year: integer year → date (January 1st)
- text: the value as text, null tokens removed

PeriodSummary.title: PeriodSummary
PeriodSummary.description: How regular the model is from one period to the next.

smooth_reason.title: Smooth Reason

QQ.title: QQ

file is matched on), and for a category read by a step, its values (to flag new ones).

RecipeDraft.title: RecipeDraft

RunRequest.description: Everything not given takes the plan's automatic choice.

sd.description: Standard deviation of a mean metric.

relative.title: Relative

ratio.title: Ratio
ratio.description: Units of each variant per control unit.

daily.title: Daily
daily.description: Units entering the test per day.

ScenarioChange.title: ScenarioChange
ScenarioChange.description:
One change of a what-if scenario (039 story 6): a known-in-advance driver moved by
`amount` % (`how="percent"`, -10 = ten percent lower) or set to `amount` (`how="value"`),
on the forecast periods from `start` to `end` (period labels such as "2025-12"; None = from
the first, or to the last, forecast period).

ScenarioOptions.title: ScenarioOptions
ScenarioOptions.description: The drivers and what changes in their future values (039 story 6).

SearchParam.title: SearchParam
SearchParam.description: One setting of the search space, as the user may change it.

SegmentPlan.description: What a segmentation with these choices would use, before running it.

SegmentRequest.title: SegmentRequest
SegmentRequest.description: Everything not given follows the app's rules.

SegmentScore.title: SegmentScore
SegmentScore.description:
How well k groups separate (higher silhouette and Calinski–Harabasz, lower Davies–Bouldin,
inertia and BIC are better).

SegmentStability.title: SegmentStability
SegmentStability.description:
Mean adjusted Rand index between the segmentation and the same method refitted on 10
subsamples of 80 % of the rows.

SequenceRequest.title: SequenceRequest
SequenceRequest.description: TimeGAN: every field not given takes the plan's choice.

SeriesConfig.title: SeriesConfig
SeriesConfig.description: A time series analysis as the Time series page keeps it (Save analysis).

SeriesDrivers.title: SeriesDrivers
SeriesDrivers.description: The columns that could explain the series (028 A4), most correlated first.

SeriesSetup.title: SeriesSetup
SeriesSetup.description: The configuration actually used: every field chosen or defaulted.

Slice.title: Slice

StepLink.description: A page of the app the step filled (the library leaves it empty).

sample (natural breaks) and, for few distinct values, each value with its count.

TimeView.title: TimeView
TimeView.description: How a date and a number was turned into a series (each setting chosen or defaulted).

UnusualCurve.title: UnusualCurve
UnusualCurve.description: Scores sorted from the most unusual row down: every listed rank, then a sampled tail.

Validation.title: Validation
